Inspections uncovered dangerously low-hanging illegal cables and numerous properties without electricity meters, relying instead on illegal connections.

Teams acted swiftly, disconnecting electricity supply to properties found to be illegally connected.

These actions help reduce pressure on the network, prevent avoidable outages and address serious safety risks, including fires and electrocution.

City Power urges residents to comply with electricity regulations and work with us to protect critical infrastructure and ensure a safer, more reliable electricity supply.

CITY POWER INTENSIFIES IMBIZO ENGAGEMENTS IN THE INNER CITY

Today, City Power continues its intensified Imbizo programme, with the latest community engagement taking place in the Inner City.

The Imbizo provides an important platform for City Power to engage directly with residents, businesses and other stakeholders on the electricity challenges affecting the area, while identifying practical solutions and strengthening collaboration with the community.

Key issues being addressed include recurring power outages, overloaded electricity infrastructure, metering and vending challenges, illegal connections and meter tampering, cable theft and vandalism, faulty streetlights, as well as network safety and security.

These challenges have a direct impact on the reliability and safety of electricity supply. City Power remains committed to addressing them through improved maintenance, infrastructure interventions, enforcement, and stronger community partnerships.

City Power relaunched its social compact with customers through a programme of regional Electricity Imbizos because persistent electricity challenges cannot be resolved only through fault tickets, technical reports and internal meetings. 

The Imbizos give us an opportunity to sit directly with communities, hear first-hand what residents are experiencing, explain the condition of the local network, account for what City Power is doing and take community concerns back into operations, metering, security and capital planning.
